'''Ana Cecilia Noguez Garrido ''' (born July 17, 1966) is a Mexican physicist, professor, and [[Science communication|science communicator]]; she is a researcher and was the first female director of the [[Institute of Physics]] of the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] from 2019 to 2023. Cecilia Noguez specializes in the interaction of light with matter on a nanometric scale. In 2016, she was awarded with the [[National Prize for Arts and Sciences (Mexico)|National Prize for Arts and Sciences]].

==Education and early career==
In May 1990, Ana Cecilia Noguez obtained her bachelor's degree in physics at the [[Faculty of Sciences (UNAM)|Faculty of Sciences]] of the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM). Since then, she has been working with the optical properties of mediums composed of nanoparticles. In 1993 and 1995, she obtained a master's degree and a doctorate in physics, respectively, also at UNAM.<ref name=ccciencias>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ccciencias.mx/es/component/spsimpleportfolio/item/310-ana-noguez-garrido-es.html |title=Ana Cecilia Noguez Garrido |publisher=Advisory Council of Sciences of the Presidency of the Republic |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-30 |archive-date=August 30, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830204739/http://www.ccciencias.mx/es/component/spsimpleportfolio/item/310-ana-noguez-garrido-es.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> As part of her PhD, Noguez spent a research stay for over one year at the [[University of Rome II]].<ref name=dgapa>{{Cite web |url=http://dgapa.unam.mx/index.php/semblanzas-anio-rdunja-2015/semblanzas-2006-rdunja-2015/348-2006a01-noguez-garrido-ana-cecilia |title=Dra. Ana Cecilia Noguez Garrido |publisher=[[National Autonomous University of Mexico|UNAM]] General Directorate of Academic Personnel Affairs |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-30}}</ref> From July 1995 to 1996, she had a postdoctoral residency at [[Ohio University]]'s Department of Physics and Astronomy. During her PhD, she also studied the optical response of semiconductor crystal surfaces.

==Career==
In 1996, Cecilia Noguez joined the Institute of Physics of UNAM, where she continues to work today. She was designated as director of the Institute of Physics for the period 2019–2023,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-05-23 |title=Ana Cecilia Noguez, directora de Física |url=https://www.gaceta.unam.mx/ana-cecilia-noguez-directora-de-fisica/ |access-date=2022-09-30 |website=Gaceta UNAM |language=es-ES}}</ref> becoming the first woman to hold the position. Along with her research work, Cecilia Noguez teaches in both undergraduate and graduate programs at UNAM. She is a member of the [[Sistema Nacional de Investigadores]] (since 1994), the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]], and the {{ill|Advisory Council of Sciences of the Presidency of the Republic|es|Consejo Consultivo de Ciencias de la Presidencia de la República}}.<ref name="ccciencias" />

Noguez has conducted theoretical and computational research to study the interaction between light and matter at the nanometer scale. Particularly, she has made contributions in order to understand how the geometry, size, composition, and the medium surrounding a nanoparticle influence its optical properties. Her work is mainly concentrated in areas such as [[plasmonics]] and surface physics.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Guerrero |first=Ana Luisa |date=2016-02-03 |title=Cecilia Noguez Garrido, investigadora de excelencia |trans-title=Cecilia Noguez Garrido, Researcher of Excellence |url=http://www.conacytprensa.mx/index.php/sociedad/personajes/5189-cecilia-noguez-garrido-investigadora-de-excelencia-entrevista-semblanza |access-date=2021-08-30 |location=Mexico City |language=Spanish |agency=Agencia Informativa Conacyt}}</ref> Her studies have contributed to the development of plasmonic nanostructures and two-dimensional films for the control of their optical activity.<ref name="ccciencias" /> Noguez's scientific contributions to the study of optical properties and [[surface plasmon]]s of metallic nanoparticles had been recognized in different occasion. For example, her work titled “Surface Plasmons on Metal Nanoparticles:  The Influence of Shape and Physical Environment”, published on the Journal of Physical Chemistry C, was recognized as the Mexican paper in physics written by one author with more cites.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sociedad Mexicana de Materiales A.C. - SMMater |url=https://www.mrs-mexico.org.mx/candidatos-1.html |access-date=2022-09-30 |website=www.mrs-mexico.org.mx}}</ref>

Cecilia Noguez has dedicated part of her trajectory to promote nanoscience in Mexico; she was part of the organization of the first network of nanoscience at UNAM (REGINA). Besides, she contributed to establish the Nanoscience Division of the Physical Mexican Society and the National Network of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology of [[Consejo Nacional de Ciencia y Tecnología (Mexico)|CONACYT]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ana Cecilia Noguez Garrido, directora del Instituto de Física de la UNAM |url=https://www.dgcs.unam.mx/boletin/bdboletin/2019_357.html |access-date=2022-09-30 |website=www.dgcs.unam.mx}}</ref> She has also participated in activities aimed to promote science among general public. In 2018, she participated as a mentor for the initiative "Niñas STEM, pueden" ([[Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics|STEM]] Girls, They Can).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Coronado |first=Leticia |date=2018-06-07 |title=Niñas STEM |url=http://mexicoysusmujeres.com.mx/ninas-stem/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180714222044/http://mexicoysusmujeres.com.mx/ninas-stem/ |archive-date=2018-07-14 |access-date=2021-08-03 |website=México y sus mujeres |language=Spanish}}</ref>

* 2009: Research Award in Exact Sciences from the Mexican Academy of Sciences<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://amc.edu.mx/amc/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=128&catid=39&Itemid=80 |title=Premios de Investigación de la Academia Mexicana de Ciencias 1961–2019 |trans-title=Research Awards of the Mexican Academy of Sciences 1961–2019 |publisher=[[Mexican Academy of Sciences]] |language=Spanish |access-date=2021-08-30}}</ref>
* 2009: [[Thomson Reuters Foundation|Thomson Reuters]]/[[CINVESTAV]] Award<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.sems.gob.mx/en_mx/sems/llama_el_secretario_lujambio_a_investigadores_a_re |title=Llama el secretario Lujambio a investigadores a refrendar su compromiso con la calidad educativa |trans-title=Secretary Lujambio Calls Researchers to Endorse Their Commitment to Educational Quality |publisher=[[Secretariat of Public Education (Mexico)|Secretariat of Public Education]] |location=Mexico City |language=Spanish |date=2009-09-29 |access-date=2021-08-30 |archive-date=August 30, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830204745/http://www.sems.gob.mx/en_mx/sems/llama_el_secretario_lujambio_a_investigadores_a_re |url-status=dead }}</ref>
